group: Financial history, stable budget identity and forecast grid
basis: Budget deletion/move guards normalize historical physical references to stable identity within owning agreement, including amendment copies. Reconcile creation supports finished claims via createReconcile operation. Lookup selected_ids enables selected hydration, validates bigint IDs and generally caps at 100. Fresh snapshots prevent inconsistent authorization/data reads. Payment voucher lookup excludes retired agencies.
